description:
About LawnStarter

LawnStarter is the nation's leading on-demand marketplace for lawn care and outdoor services, with over $150M in annual bookings. We're expanding beyond lawn care into the one-stop shop for all home services. Getting there depends on how fast we can test, learn, and scale what works.

About The Data Team

We're a high-leverage team of Product Data Analysts embedded across the business, owning the semantic layer and the metrics everyone trusts. The experimentation program runs on real rigor, not vibes: pre-registered analysis plans gate every test launch, anytime-valid statistics keep mid-run dashboards honest under continuous viewing, automated daily SRM and attribution health sweeps catch broken tests early, and seasonal power forecasting accounts for a business that swings hard by time of year. The test lifecycle, design through readout, is already AI-driven. Our analysts are stretched across product, so Growth support has stayed part-time and reactive, until now.

The Role

You're the first data analyst dedicated entirely to Growth and Experimentation. Your primary charter is the experimentation program: test design, statistical rigor, and readouts across web funnels, SMS/drip, sales-driven tests, and SEO tests built on our own page-clustering tooling. It's a wider surface than most companies run. You also own the acquisition-to-conversion funnel those tests move, across paid, organic, and partner channels. What to test and which direction to bet on is the CRO's and Growth PMs' call; you shape it, they decide it.

You're not starting from scratch. Dashboards, tooling, and rigor scaffolding are already shipped and running. Expect the early months to be hands-on and manual: scoping tests, crunching readouts, while you build toward a self-serve layer. If a test readout and a funnel refresh ever compete for your week, the test wins.

What Makes This Role Different


The CEO personally engages with test design here: real organizational weight, no fight for buy-in
You partner directly with the Director of CRO, performance marketing, and Growth PMs, who come to you when a test needs a call


Requirements

What You'll Own


Experimentation rigor: test design, power and sample-size calls, significance and readout standards. Core of the role: you catch underpowered tests and false positives before they become bad decisions, and you get Growth's tests onto the anytime-valid monitoring the program already runs, so early calls come from a crossed boundary instead of a hopeful trend read
The self-serve experimentation layer: automated Growth metrics in Lightdash, Python-backed stat-sig tooling, and the AI skills (Claude routines) already handling pre-test power calcs and live-test health checks. You extend these and keep the layer correct as product and tracking evolve
The Growth funnel model: a trusted, instrumented view of visitor → lead → customer across every brand and channel, with the CAC, LTV, and conversion-rate cuts Growth needs to prioritize investment
The Growth analytics function model: by end of Year 1, the standards and playbook that scale this function beyond one person, plus a buy-vs-build recommendation for the experimentation stack (an off-the-shelf stats engine, or extending our own skills and Python). You bring the recommendation; the final call isn't yours alone


Problems to Solve

Tests that can't answer the question they were run for Growth wants more experiments, but volume without rigor produces confident, wrong conclusions. Raising the bar without becoming the bottleneck is the job.

Getting off the manual treadmill Real tooling already exists: test-design helpers, dashboards, AI skills. Most tests are still hands-on and bespoke. How do you extend that automation so routine cases genuinely self-serve?

Making the funnel decision-grade The semantic layer defines the funnel, but instrumentation is uneven across brands and channels, and no one owns the single trusted view. You build it, and you keep it trusted.

Turning analysis into decisions The hard part isn't the SQL. It's getting a PM or marketer to change course. Can you deliver insight sharp enough that the room acts, and push back when the data favors the popular but wrong idea?

What Success Looks Like (Year 1)


Rigor is the default. Power calculations are standard practice, early stops on Growth tests come from the anytime-valid boundary rather than a trend read, and the re-run rate (redone for tracking or attribution problems) is down
Routine tests self-serve. Metrics and stat-sig are automated in Lightdash, so the team reads standard results without filing a ticket, and your time goes to the tests that need an analyst
A funnel Growth trusts. The acquisition→conversion funnel is instrumented across every brand and channel; Growth prioritizes off your model, not side spreadsheets
Measurable conversion wins. Your analysis directly drove specific, quantified lifts in the funnel, and you can name them


Who You Are

AI-native. You use AI daily for SQL, dbt, and pressure-testing your analysis, extending the skills already running our experimentation process rather than merely using them. This is unlikely to be a good fit if you're skeptical of AI or treat your workflow as fixed.

A partner, not a report-writer. You don't wait for a ticket. You sit close to Growth and bring the question before anyone asks it. Skip this one if you want a clear queue with no expectation to push back.

Statistically sharp. Wrong fit if "we hit significance" ends your analysis instead of starting it. Right fit if you have a point of view on test design (power, significance, novelty and interaction effects, when not to test) and can explain a broken experiment in plain terms.

Fluent in experiment instrumentation. You know how Segment events and Flagsmith randomization interact, and catch a tracking problem before a test ships, keeping our re-run rate down. This isn't for you if instrumentation is someone else's job.

Fluent in the funnel. You think in CAC, LTV, and channel economics, and know acquisition data's quirks: attribution messiness, seasonality, channel mix. Skip this one if your background is pure product-feature analytics.

Technically self-sufficient. Wrong fit if you need clean data handed to you. Expert SQL, enough Python to automate the stat-sig math, and comfort in dbt and Lightdash, building your own models without waiting on data engineering.

Influences without authority. PMs and marketers act on what you find because your insight is clear and honest about uncertainty. This isn't for you if you consider the job done once the analysis ships, regardless of outcome.

This Role Is NOT


A ticket queue. Not the role if you want well-defined asks: no one hands you a backlog of number-pulls, you decide what's worth measuring
The person who decides what to test. You shape that call and own its rigor, but the roadmap and final direction belong to the CRO and Growth PMs
A product-feature analyst seat. Existing analysts already own product, pricing, and service delivery; this one lives in Growth: acquisition, conversion, experimentation
A pure platform or dashboard-builder. You'll automate metrics, stat-sig, and AI skills into a self-serve layer, but that's the means. The job is designing experiments and keeping that automation correct as product and tracking evolve
A people-management role. This is an individual-contributor seat

Flexible PTO: Measured on outcomes, not hours logged

description:
About LawnStarter

LawnStarter is the nation's leading on-demand marketplace for lawn care and outdoor services, with over $150M in annual bookings. We're expanding beyond lawn care into the one-stop shop for all home services. Getting there depends on how fast we can test, learn, and scale what works.

About The Data Team

We're a high-leverage team of Product Data Analysts embedded across the business, owning the semantic layer and the metrics everyone trusts. The experimentation program runs on real rigor, not vibes: pre-registered analysis plans gate every test launch, anytime-valid statistics keep mid-run dashboards honest under continuous viewing, automated daily SRM and attribution health sweeps catch broken tests early, and seasonal power forecasting accounts for a business that swings hard by time of year. The test lifecycle, design through readout, is already AI-driven. Our analysts are stretched across product, so Growth support has stayed part-time and reactive, until now.

The Role

You're the first data analyst dedicated entirely to Growth and Experimentation. Your primary charter is the experimentation program: test design, statistical rigor, and readouts across web funnels, SMS/drip, sales-driven tests, and SEO tests built on our own page-clustering tooling. It's a wider surface than most companies run. You also own the acquisition-to-conversion funnel those tests move, across paid, organic, and partner channels. What to test and which direction to bet on is the CRO's and Growth PMs' call; you shape it, they decide it.

You're not starting from scratch. Dashboards, tooling, and rigor scaffolding are already shipped and running. Expect the early months to be hands-on and manual: scoping tests, crunching readouts, while you build toward a self-serve layer. If a test readout and a funnel refresh ever compete for your week, the test wins.

What Makes This Role Different


The CEO personally engages with test design here: real organizational weight, no fight for buy-in
You partner directly with the Director of CRO, performance marketing, and Growth PMs, who come to you when a test needs a call


Requirements

What You'll Own


Experimentation rigor: test design, power and sample-size calls, significance and readout standards. Core of the role: you catch underpowered tests and false positives before they become bad decisions, and you get Growth's tests onto the anytime-valid monitoring the program already runs, so early calls come from a crossed boundary instead of a hopeful trend read
The self-serve experimentation layer: automated Growth metrics in Lightdash, Python-backed stat-sig tooling, and the AI skills (Claude routines) already handling pre-test power calcs and live-test health checks. You extend these and keep the layer correct as product and tracking evolve
The Growth funnel model: a trusted, instrumented view of visitor → lead → customer across every brand and channel, with the CAC, LTV, and conversion-rate cuts Growth needs to prioritize investment
The Growth analytics function model: by end of Year 1, the standards and playbook that scale this function beyond one person, plus a buy-vs-build recommendation for the experimentation stack (an off-the-shelf stats engine, or extending our own skills and Python). You bring the recommendation; the final call isn't yours alone


Problems to Solve

Tests that can't answer the question they were run for Growth wants more experiments, but volume without rigor produces confident, wrong conclusions. Raising the bar without becoming the bottleneck is the job.

Getting off the manual treadmill Real tooling already exists: test-design helpers, dashboards, AI skills. Most tests are still hands-on and bespoke. How do you extend that automation so routine cases genuinely self-serve?

Making the funnel decision-grade The semantic layer defines the funnel, but instrumentation is uneven across brands and channels, and no one owns the single trusted view. You build it, and you keep it trusted.

Turning analysis into decisions The hard part isn't the SQL. It's getting a PM or marketer to change course. Can you deliver insight sharp enough that the room acts, and push back when the data favors the popular but wrong idea?

What Success Looks Like (Year 1)


Rigor is the default. Power calculations are standard practice, early stops on Growth tests come from the anytime-valid boundary rather than a trend read, and the re-run rate (redone for tracking or attribution problems) is down
Routine tests self-serve. Metrics and stat-sig are automated in Lightdash, so the team reads standard results without filing a ticket, and your time goes to the tests that need an analyst
A funnel Growth trusts. The acquisition→conversion funnel is instrumented across every brand and channel; Growth prioritizes off your model, not side spreadsheets
Measurable conversion wins. Your analysis directly drove specific, quantified lifts in the funnel, and you can name them


Who You Are

AI-native. You use AI daily for SQL, dbt, and pressure-testing your analysis, extending the skills already running our experimentation process rather than merely using them. This is unlikely to be a good fit if you're skeptical of AI or treat your workflow as fixed.

A partner, not a report-writer. You don't wait for a ticket. You sit close to Growth and bring the question before anyone asks it. Skip this one if you want a clear queue with no expectation to push back.

Statistically sharp. Wrong fit if "we hit significance" ends your analysis instead of starting it. Right fit if you have a point of view on test design (power, significance, novelty and interaction effects, when not to test) and can explain a broken experiment in plain terms.

Fluent in experiment instrumentation. You know how Segment events and Flagsmith randomization interact, and catch a tracking problem before a test ships, keeping our re-run rate down. This isn't for you if instrumentation is someone else's job.

Fluent in the funnel. You think in CAC, LTV, and channel economics, and know acquisition data's quirks: attribution messiness, seasonality, channel mix. Skip this one if your background is pure product-feature analytics.

Technically self-sufficient. Wrong fit if you need clean data handed to you. Expert SQL, enough Python to automate the stat-sig math, and comfort in dbt and Lightdash, building your own models without waiting on data engineering.

Influences without authority. PMs and marketers act on what you find because your insight is clear and honest about uncertainty. This isn't for you if you consider the job done once the analysis ships, regardless of outcome.

This Role Is NOT


A ticket queue. Not the role if you want well-defined asks: no one hands you a backlog of number-pulls, you decide what's worth measuring
The person who decides what to test. You shape that call and own its rigor, but the roadmap and final direction belong to the CRO and Growth PMs
A product-feature analyst seat. Existing analysts already own product, pricing, and service delivery; this one lives in Growth: acquisition, conversion, experimentation
A pure platform or dashboard-builder. You'll automate metrics, stat-sig, and AI skills into a self-serve layer, but that's the means. The job is designing experiments and keeping that automation correct as product and tracking evolve
A people-management role. This is an individual-contributor seat

Remote (LATAM) · Reports to our Co-CEO

Viva’s gearing up for its next growth phase. We need you to build our marketing function from the ground up and improve/accelerate the sustainable pipeline of qualified buyers that drives more revenue.

The work you’ll do will be pivotal to Viva’s growth, revenue, and team and will directly impact how we reach our mission of creating 1,000 meaningful career opportunities across Latin America.

We invest heavily in our people through:

title: Social Media Specialist
skills: Collaborate with internal teams to translate marketing objectives into social strategies.
Execute strategic social campaign planning for individual marketing campaigns and projects.
Develop an organic content strategy and handles the editorial calendar including the scheduling via Khoros Marketing or any similar scheduling platform.
Copywriting, Generate creative assets (Using tools such as Canva/Adobe), and manage related processes.
Daily use of social media channels for reporting, analytics, and trend tools (including but not limited to: Spreadfast, Trello, Adobe Web Analytics).
Moderate and respond to all social media engagement (replies, comments, messages) with an excellent customer service attitude.
Test, optimize, and report global campaign results on an ongoing basis across multiple social media channels and present to internal stakeholders.
Proactively identify campaign issues and formulate actionable solutions based off findings.
Understand the company’s business objectives to effectively translate them into social media campaign goals and strategies.
Monitor social media trends, best practices and techniques to ensure correct account spend/growth, identify new opportunities and optimize user experience through analytics and A/B testing.
Clearly communicate work status, potential issues, and successes with team, internal stakeholders, and external agency.
Strong communication skills: you will be able to craft your ideas and messages to fit a variety of channels and contexts both in short and long form.

Organizational skills: This is a fast-paced job and may require managing multiple projects simultaneously. You need to be able to stay on top of them, and always be able to communicate where things are.
Natural networker: this role involves developing positive relationships with a variety of internal and external stakeholders and our brand’s audience on social media.

Good judgment: You will decide how to handle engagement from our audience - how to respond appropriately in real-time and in a variety of contexts. You will be the voice of our brand in social media and must represent NI every day in a way that treats our customers well, portrays us positively in the community, and helps move the business forward.

Adaptability: You will wear a lot of hats in this role as you support our social channels for multiple programs. On any giving day you’ll be a copywriter, editor, customer support specialist, PR representative, creative director, and project manager.
Bachelor’s degree.
3-5 years of experience in digital marketing; including experience with the management of social media accounts for a brand.
Has direct experience either personally or professionally with the following channels: LinkedIn, YouTube, Facebook, X (formerly Twitter), YouTube, and Instagram.
Fast and independent learner when it comes to software, apps, and digital tools.
Experience in managing and creating B-to-B content.
Experience working in an international corporate environment and/or with global social media channels.
Strong initiative and resourcefulness; highly self-motivated.
Passion for data and data-driven decision making; strong analytical skills.
Ability to communicate results to management and in a fast-paced environment.

skills: Role Title: Research Marketing Lead (Remote)
Role Type: Full-time
Location: Remote
description:
Role Title: Research Marketing Lead (Remote)
Role Type: Full-time
Location: Remote




The Role

We’re looking for a Research Marketing Lead to own how our research, benchmarks, and technical work are positioned, launched, and adopted across the AI ecosystem.




You’ll work closely with our research team to turn technical work into high-impact launches that earn attention, adoption, and citations. You’ll develop a deep understanding of our research and methodology, shape positioning and narratives, establish a high quality bar for publication, and build go-to-market strategies that put our work in front of the right researchers, developers, AI labs, and technical audiences.




What You'll Do

1. Own research GTM end-to-end, developing launch and distribution strategies for research, benchmarks, evaluations, and other technical work.

2. Establish the publication-readiness bar for research and benchmarks, partnering with researchers to ensure methodology, claims, results, and supporting materials are rigorous, clear, and defensible before launch.

3. Develop positioning and narratives that translate complex technical findings into clear, differentiated stories without sacrificing technical accuracy or depth.

4. Identify high-impact research opportunities by understanding emerging AI trends, open questions, competitive research, and what matters to researchers and practitioners.

5. Shape research packaging and distribution, including research pages, benchmark releases, technical content, launch materials, and other assets that drive discovery and usage.

6. Build relationships across the AI research ecosystem, including researchers, AI labs, developers, technical communities, and influential practitioners.

7. Drive adoption of our research and benchmarks, identifying the audiences, communities, and channels most likely to use, reference, and build on our work.

8. Measure research impact, tracking adoption, citations, engagement, usage, and qualitative feedback to understand what resonates and where our work is creating value.

9. Create feedback loops between the market and research, bringing ecosystem insights back to the research team to inform future benchmarks, evaluations, and research priorities.




What We're Looking For

1. Experience marketing, launching, or driving adoption of technical research, AI/ML products, developer products, benchmarks, evaluations, or similarly complex technical work.

2. Strong track record developing and executing go-to-market strategies for technical audiences.

3. Ability to deeply understand technical work and translate it into clear, credible, differentiated positioning and narratives.

4. Strong understanding of the AI/ML research ecosystem, including major labs, research trends, benchmarks, evaluations, and technical communities.

5. Exceptional written communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with both highly technical and broader audiences.

6. Strong analytical judgment and the ability to evaluate whether technical claims, supporting evidence, and research materials are ready for external publication.

7. Experience building relationships with researchers, technical leaders, developers, or AI communities.

8. High ownership and the ability to take ambiguous initiatives from strategy through execution.

9. Strong cross-functional skills and the ability to work closely with researchers while maintaining a high bar for technical accuracy and quality.




Preferred

1. Background in AI, machine learning, computer science, or another technical field.

2. Experience at an AI lab, AI-native company, research organization, developer-focused company, or highly technical startup.

3. Experience working directly with research teams and technical leadership.

4. Familiarity with academic publishing, AI benchmarks, evaluations, citations, and research dissemination.

5. Experience launching technical content or research that achieved meaningful adoption, citations, community engagement, or industry impact.




Compensation & Benefits Notice

The national pay range for this full-time position is base salary of $150,000 –$210,000. All employees are eligible for equity compensation, and employees may also receive performance-based bonuses, dependent on role and subject to company policies. micro1 provides a comprehensive benefits package, including up to 100% reimbursement for health-insurance premiums, paid time off, a 401(K) plan with a company match, and additional benefits designed to support a high-performing, remote-first workforce.




micro1 is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. If you need assistance and/or a reasonable accommodation during the application process, reach out to support@micro1.ai.




Our hiring process utilizes artificial intelligence tools to assist in candidate screening and assessment. Our AI tools are designed to complement, not replace, human decision-making.

description:
About Conduit

Conduit is building the rails that power the next generation of cross-border fintech. Our global USD account infrastructure and payment API are used by fintechs, embedded finance platforms, and financial institutions moving money across LatAm, Africa, and beyond.

We believe in a world of fair economic opportunity, where global commerce can flourish through the frictionless exchange of value. Our first steps toward that vision are enabling drastically faster, cheaper, and more reliable financial services infrastructure — and we're backed by investors who share that conviction, including Dragonfly, Circle, and Coinbase.

We're here to build, and we mean that. We empower our team to act like founders, make bold decisions, and deliver outsized outcomes. If you're energized by hard problems, big markets, and real ownership over your work, you'll fit right in.

Role Overview

This is the second hire on Conduit's growing Customer Success team, and a role with immediate impact on company-wide goals and revenue initiatives. Being this early means rolling up your sleeves and serving as the primary point of contact for our API and dashboard clients. We want someone curious enough to dig into the root cause of an issue and solve it for good, not just apply the immediate fix.

You'll also have the opportunity to automate systems, improve processes, and help define what customer success looks like at Conduit as the team scales.

What You'll Do


Serve as the primary point of contact for production support, onboarding, and activations for our API and dashboard clients
Own the client onboarding journey, from kickoff and technical integration through compliance review and first live transactions
Troubleshoot integration and payment issues, identify root causes, and partner with Engineering and Product to keep them from recurring
Work across every function at Conduit, including Engineering, Product, Compliance, Operations, and Sales, to deliver a world-class customer experience
Drive engagement with existing clients, learning their roadmaps to find opportunities for Conduit to add value, expand usage, and grow revenue
Work with CRM, contact center software, and marketing tools to optimize how we manage and communicate with our clients
Spot repetitive work and replace it with automations, playbooks, and documentation that help the team scale
Track client health and usage, and bring product feedback and trends back to the team to help shape Conduit's roadmap


Qualifications


1 to 3 years of experience managing fintech or API clients in a customer success, implementation, or technical account management role
A proven record of turning customer success into revenue outcomes, such as expansion, retention, or increased transaction volume
An ownership mindset. We're a startup, and everyone at Conduit takes things from 0 to 1, even when they've never done it before
Sound judgment on when to escalate, and no hesitation in doing so when we have the opportunity or responsibility to deliver for our clients
Comfort with technical concepts, such as reading API documentation, understanding webhooks, and using tools like Postman to reproduce issues
Clear, confident communication with both technical and business stakeholders
Must be able to be comfortable speaking English (English fluency is preferred)
Hands-on experience with CRM and support tools such as HubSpot, Pylon, or similar
Bonus: familiarity with cross-border payments, stablecoins, or KYB/KYC processes
Bonus: professional proficiency in Spanish or Portuguese


Why Conduit

Conduit is building the infrastructure layer for the next generation of global payments. We're looking for a customer success professional who can turn that momentum into lasting client relationships and revenue growth, and who wants to help build a Customer Success function from the ground up in a market that's moving fast. If that's you, let's talk.

description:
Description

At Gigamon, our purpose is to protect the hybrid networks and data of the largest, most complex organizations on the planet. Certified as a Great Place to Work, we offer a deep observability pipeline that efficiently delivers network-derived intelligence to cloud, security, and observability tools. This helps our customers to eliminate security blind spots, optimize network traffic, and dramatically reduce tool cost and complexity, enabling them to better secure and manage their hybrid cloud infrastructure. Gigamon has served more than 4,000 customers worldwide, including over 80 percent of Fortune 100 enterprises, 9 of the 10 largest mobile network providers, and hundreds of governments and educational organizations.

The Customer Success Engineer (CSE) is a highly technical, customer-facing role within our Customer Success organization that bridges technical credibility with strategic customer engagement. You will act as a trusted technical advisor and partner to customers and internal account teams, helping drive onboarding, adoption, retention, and expansion. By aligning Gigamon’s technical capabilities to customer business outcomes, you will help customers realize value quickly and navigate complex environments with confidence. This role is focused on technical guidance, cross-functional coordination, and customer advocacy rather than hands-on break-fix or production system administration.

What You’ll Do


Partner with Customer Success Managers to support onboarding, adoption, retention, and expansion across strategic customer accounts.
Serve as a trusted technical advisor by explaining architecture, deployment considerations, best practices, and solution value in a clear and accessible way.
Help customers connect Gigamon technical capabilities to their business outcomes, success criteria, and long-term adoption goals.
Identify technical risks, adoption blockers, and customer friction points early, and coordinate the right internal resources to address them.
Collaborate closely with Solutions Engineering, Technical Support, Professional Services, Product, and Sales to ensure a seamless and consistent customer experience.
Participate in customer meetings, success plan reviews, escalations, and account strategy discussions as the technical voice within the Customer Success motion.
Translate complex technical concepts for non-technical and executive audiences with clarity and confidence.
Capture and communicate customer feedback, recurring themes, and product gaps to internal stakeholders to inform product and process improvements.
Create, maintain, and improve internal and customer-facing documentation such as best practice guides, enablement materials, process documentation, and technical adoption resources.
Support renewal and growth motions by reinforcing solution value, technical fit, and adoption progress.
Build strong, trusted customer relationships through responsiveness, sound judgment, and a calm, consultative approach during both routine interactions and escalations.


What You’ve Done


5+ years of experience in a customer-facing technical role such as Solutions Engineer, Technical Account Manager, Customer Success Engineer, Technical Support Engineer, Technical Consultant, or similar.
Worked with enterprise customers in a post-sales, technical advisory, support, or customer success capacity.
Demonstrated strong foundational knowledge of networking, cloud, and enterprise infrastructure concepts.
Gained familiarity with Linux, common deployment models, and hybrid customer environments.
Developed working knowledge of cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, and GCP.
Shown the ability to understand and discuss technical architectures, integrations, and operational considerations without needing to perform direct hands-on administration in production systems.
Effectively recognized when customer issues require escalation to Technical Support, Professional Services, or Engineering and coordinated those transitions.
Proven ability to work cross-functionally and influence outcomes without direct authority.
Earned a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or equivalent practical experience.
(Preferred) Supported customers in SaaS, on-premise, or hybrid deployment models.
(Preferred) Gained familiarity with Kubernetes, Nutanix, and modern cloud platforms.
(Preferred) Built experience in cybersecurity, observability, infrastructure, or related enterprise technology domains, ideally in a fast-paced B2B enterprise software environment.


Who You Are


Emotionally intelligent and empathetic, able to navigate escalations and sensitive situations with professionalism and composure.
An excellent communicator, with strong written and verbal skills and the ability to explain complex technical topics to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
A strong listener who can de-escalate tense situations, build trust, and maintain credibility with customers and internal teams.
Highly organized, with the ability to manage multiple stakeholders, competing priorities, and follow-through on commitments.
Consultative and collaborative, with a customer-first mindset and a focus on driving business outcomes rather than hands-on break-fix work.
Comfortable operating in cross-functional environments and influencing without direct authority to ensure customers have the right technical guidance and internal advocacy throughout their journey.

description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

 

About the role:

Our Customer Success Managers pick up where our Implementation team leaves off, working closely with our customers to understand their fleet and unique challenges, advising on how to customize Samsara for their needs, and becoming their long-term partner.

Your role will be cross-functional in nature, working alongside and connecting Sales, Support, Sales Engineering and Product, enabling you to experience multiple aspects of a hyper-growth company from within.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in Mexico. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role. This position requires travel up to 30% of the time.

You should apply if:

You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
You’re energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.
You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-calibre team that will encourage you to do your best.

In this role, you will: 

Be on the front-lines and ensure our customers increase the safety, efficiency, and sustainability of their operations with our IoT platform
Compose joint success plans with customers, outlining their objectives, metrics, timelines, and effectively removing any barriers to achieving business value
Orchestrate renewal-focused business reviews with our customers where we look back at past successes and align on upcoming goals
Deeply understand the Samsara platform’s capabilities and explain them to businesses of all types - field services, utilities, long-haul transportation, school buses, and many more
Mitigate escalations and resolve customer issues
Help Customers with a wide range of general inquiries and questions
Solve customer issues and escalations about Samsara products and services
Experience in multi-channel servicing including excellent phone skills and good writing skills for Web, email, and channel requests
Ability to prioritize work queue and backlog in addition to incoming customer requests
Provide excellent customer service throughout the service cycle from initial request to final close out of the transaction
Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for the role:

2-5 years of experience in a Customer Success, account management, or consulting role. SaaS experience preferred
Experience supporting or working with technical products
Solutions-oriented with strong problem-solving skills
Passion for going above and beyond the call of duty, taking initiative, and thriving in a fast-paced, change-heavy environment
Bachelor’s degree from a 4-year institution
Spanish and English fluency
IA tools fluency (Claude/ Pilot/ Gemini, others)

An ideal candidate also has:

Has strong bias for standardization & automation, the ability to think big, with insistence on high standards
Thrives in a fast-paced and change-heavy environment
 

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations 

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

 

About the role:

Our Customer Success Managers pick up where our Implementation team leaves off, working closely with our customers to understand their fleet and unique challenges, advising on how to customize Samsara for their needs, and becoming their long-term partner.

Your role will be cross-functional in nature, working alongside and connecting Sales, Support, Sales Engineering and Product, enabling you to experience multiple aspects of a hyper-growth company from within.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in Mexico. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role. This position requires travel up to 30% of the time.

You should apply if:

You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
You’re energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.
You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-calibre team that will encourage you to do your best.

In this role, you will: 

Be on the front-lines and ensure our customers increase the safety, efficiency, and sustainability of their operations with our IoT platform
Compose joint success plans with customers, outlining their objectives, metrics, timelines, and effectively removing any barriers to achieving business value
Orchestrate renewal-focused business reviews with our customers where we look back at past successes and align on upcoming goals
Deeply understand the Samsara platform’s capabilities and explain them to businesses of all types - field services, utilities, long-haul transportation, school buses, and many more
Mitigate escalations and resolve customer issues
Help Customers with a wide range of general inquiries and questions
Solve customer issues and escalations about Samsara products and services
Experience in multi-channel servicing including excellent phone skills and good writing skills for Web, email, and channel requests
Ability to prioritize work queue and backlog in addition to incoming customer requests
Provide excellent customer service throughout the service cycle from initial request to final close out of the transaction
Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for the role:

2-5 years of experience in a Customer Success, account management, or consulting role. SaaS experience preferred
Experience supporting or working with technical products
Solutions-oriented with strong problem-solving skills
Passion for going above and beyond the call of duty, taking initiative, and thriving in a fast-paced, change-heavy environment
Bachelor’s degree from a 4-year institution
Spanish and English fluency
IA tools fluency (Claude/ Pilot/ Gemini, others)

An ideal candidate also has:

Has strong bias for standardization & automation, the ability to think big, with insistence on high standards
Thrives in a fast-paced and change-heavy environment
 

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations 

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

 

About the role:

Our Customer Success Managers pick up where our Implementation team leaves off, working closely with our customers to understand their fleet and unique challenges, advising on how to customize Samsara for their needs, and becoming their long-term partner.

Your role will be cross-functional in nature, working alongside and connecting Sales, Support, Sales Engineering and Product, enabling you to experience multiple aspects of a hyper-growth company from within.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in Mexico. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role. This position requires travel up to 30% of the time.

You should apply if:

You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
You’re energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.
You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-calibre team that will encourage you to do your best.

In this role, you will: 

Be on the front-lines and ensure our customers increase the safety, efficiency, and sustainability of their operations with our IoT platform
Compose joint success plans with customers, outlining their objectives, metrics, timelines, and effectively removing any barriers to achieving business value
Orchestrate renewal-focused business reviews with our customers where we look back at past successes and align on upcoming goals
Deeply understand the Samsara platform’s capabilities and explain them to businesses of all types - field services, utilities, long-haul transportation, school buses, and many more
Mitigate escalations and resolve customer issues
Help Customers with a wide range of general inquiries and questions
Solve customer issues and escalations about Samsara products and services
Experience in multi-channel servicing including excellent phone skills and good writing skills for Web, email, and channel requests
Ability to prioritize work queue and backlog in addition to incoming customer requests
Provide excellent customer service throughout the service cycle from initial request to final close out of the transaction
Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for the role:

2-5 years of experience in a Customer Success, account management, or consulting role. SaaS experience preferred
Experience supporting or working with technical products
Solutions-oriented with strong problem-solving skills
Passion for going above and beyond the call of duty, taking initiative, and thriving in a fast-paced, change-heavy environment
Bachelor’s degree from a 4-year institution
Spanish and English fluency
IA tools fluency (Claude/ Pilot/ Gemini, others)

An ideal candidate also has:

Has strong bias for standardization & automation, the ability to think big, with insistence on high standards
Thrives in a fast-paced and change-heavy environment
 

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations 

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

title: Integrations Analyst
description:
Role Mission




We are looking for a Technical Integrations Analyst to ensure that Monato's clients successfully connect to our financial infrastructure, reducing technical friction during integrations and accelerating platform adoption.







Why This Role Matters




In fintech, a product's journey doesn't end when it's built—it begins when it's integrated. This role ensures that client implementations are seamless, clear, and reliable, directly contributing to platform growth and the business's operational stability.







What You'll Do




• Work with APIs and operational workflows.




• Support clients throughout the implementation process, including sandbox testing and request/response validation.




• Analyze implementations to identify friction points, recurring errors, and opportunities to improve integration workflows.




• Collaborate with Product and Engineering teams to resolve technical blockers during integrations.




• Review logs, API requests, and technical documentation to diagnose integration issues.




• Document integration processes and develop clear guidelines for clients and internal teams, including post-mortem analyses of incidents.

Profile & Key Skills




• Bachelor's degree in Systems Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related technical field.




• Basic programming knowledge (Python, SQL, or similar languages).




• Understanding of APIs and system integrations, with the ability to read technical documentation and logs.




• Advanced English proficiency (reading, writing, and speaking).




• Analytical mindset and a genuine interest in troubleshooting technical issues.




• Advanced proficiency in Excel / Google Sheets for operational analysis.




• Ability to clearly document technical processes and explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.




• Nice to have: Previous experience with API testing tools (Postman or similar), monitoring tools, or exposure to payment workflows.







What You'll Gain




• Direct exposure to APIs, payment flows, and real-world financial infrastructure.




• Close collaboration with Product, Engineering, and client teams.




• A role with real ownership over how the platform connects with the market.




• Accelerated professional growth within a fintech company in its building and scaling phase.




• Opportunities to propose improvements, document processes, and build solutions with a direct impact on the business.







About Monato




At Monato, we build modern financial infrastructure for businesses in Mexico, enabling seamless and secure integration of financial services. We operate in a regulated environment where stability and compliance are essential, designing solutions that reduce banking friction and empower our clients to grow. We are an execution-driven team focused on building, iterating, and continuously improving.

description:
Description

The Amazon Mexico team is looking for a talented, smart, and entrepreneurial Sr Product Manager to help us lead highly complex, high-impact initiatives that shape how millions of customers receive and return their orders.

This is a high-visibility role with leadership-level exposure. You will define and deliver products that require deep technical acumen, customer obsession, data analytics, strong business judgment, and an ability to work across a broad range of stakeholders including WW and Local program management, product management, business intelligence engineering, software engineering, category, legal, operations, taxes, machine learning, supply chain, and finance teams.

We are looking for a leader with super-powers in customer experience, analytics, and getting things done (a not-that-frequent combination!). S/he should be a self-starter that thrives in ambiguity, with the ability to influence multi-functionally, and the willingness to roll up sleeves to execute in a dynamic environment.

As a Returns Experience Sr Product Manager you will lead channel-agnostic initiatives to solve for customer experience pain-points across their post-purchase and returns journey in Mexico.

Your initiatives will shape strategy, drive customer satisfaction, and drive business growth and profitability across one of Amazon's most critical areas.

The role focuses on identifying opportunities and gaps in our post-purchase & returns experience which may include opportunities in our concessions & returns policies, returns resolutions, product lifecycle support (PLS), catalog and fulfillment, channel parity gaps, operating procedures, product/program's logic, etc. While designing, developing and executing a comprehensive master plan with strategic initiatives to improve the way we serve our customers.

A successful candidate will develop a strong understanding of our business, customers and implement data-driven solutions with direct impact in customers and Amazon's growth.

Key job responsibilities

Strategic Solutions Development And Launch

Drive customer-centric innovation, using data to deeply understand pain points and craft scalable solutions. You follow Amazon product development best practices and work backwards to identify gaps and defects in customers shopping and post-purchase journey. You make use of business & customer research and quantitative analysis. You identify emerging use cases and clarify how they differ from existing solutions. You are data-driven and understand the risk of action. You understand a broad range of analytics techniques and know when to use them.

Program And Product Management

Own the end-to-end product strategy, roadmap, and execution for key components of the Product Lifecycle Support (PLS) and Returns Experience (RCX).

Owning the end-to-end launch of programs, features and initiatives to improve the Product Lifecycle Support (PLS) and Returns Experience (RCX) and manage product portfolio once launched. Align product vision with long-term business goals and influence cross-functional teams to deliver on that vision. Standardize processes across different business units, channels, and align recommended processes with stakeholders.

Continuous Improvement

Own Returns experience and Product lifecycle support (PLS) at a process level. Define and monitor metrics, perform root cause analysis on defects and implement remediation; own continuous improvement strategy. Function as a main point of contact for escalations, coordinating multi-functionally to provide advice, implement solutions, and monitor resolutions.

About The Team

Inclusive team culture

At Amazon we embrace our differences and we are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. We host annual and ongoing learning experiences. Amazon’s culture of inclusion is reinforced within our 14 Leadership Principles, which remind team members to seek diverse perspectives, learn and be curious, and earn trust.

Work Life Balance

We believe striking the right balance between your personal and professional life is critical to life-long happiness and fulfillment. We offer flexibility in working hours and encourage you to find your own balance between your work and personal lives.

Mentorship & Career Growth

Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects based on what will help each team member develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic Qualifications


 5+ years of product or program management, product marketing, business development or technology experience
 Bachelor's degree or equivalent
 Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
 Experience with end to end product delivery
 Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
 Experience as a product manager or owner
 Experience owning technology products
 Speak, write, and read fluently in English, and have the ability to take direction in English
 +3 YOE managing technical products or online services
 +3 YOE in product, program, or project management in leading cross-functional teams in delivery of major new products or services


Preferred Qualifications


 Experience in influencing senior leadership through data driven insights
 Experience working across functional teams and senior stakeholders


Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. description:
Description

The Amazon Mexico team is looking for a talented, smart, and entrepreneurial Sr Product Manager to help us lead highly complex, high-impact initiatives that shape how millions of customers receive and return their orders from international fulfillment channels.

This is a high-visibility role with leadership-level exposure. You will define and deliver products that require deep technical acumen, data analytics, strong business judgment, and an ability to work across a broad range of WW and Local stakeholders including tech, other product managers, operations, supply chain, software engineering, category, legal, taxes, and finance teams.

We are looking for a leader with super-powers in analytics and getting things done (a not-that-frequent combination!). S/he should be a self-starter that thrives in ambiguity, with the ability to influence multi-functionally, and the willingness to roll up sleeves to execute in a dynamic environment.

As an NCRC & Returns Sr. PM, you will lead initiatives to enhance the customer experience in returns, solve for delivery and returns defects, reduce the cost of returns, and minimize Amazon-controllable refunds and concessions.

Your initiatives will shape strategy, drive customer satisfaction, and drive business growth and profitability across one of Amazon's most critical areas.

The role focuses on identifying opportunities and gaps in concessions & returns policies, operating procedures, network and product/program's logic, while designing, developing and executing a comprehensive master plan with strategic initiatives to improve the way we serve our customers.

A successful candidate will develop a strong understanding of our business and implement data-driven solutions with direct impact in Amazon's profitability.

Key job responsibilities

Strategic Solutions Development And Launch

Drive customer-centric innovation, using data to deeply understand pain points and craft scalable solutions. You follow Amazon product development best practices and work backwards to identify gaps and defects in customers shopping journey. You make use of business research and statistical analysis. You identify emerging use cases and clarify how they differ from existing solutions. You are data-driven and understand the risk of action. You understand a broad range of analytics techniques and know when to use them.

Program And Product Management

Own the end-to-end product strategy, roadmap, and execution for key components of the Delivery and Returns Experience.

Sr PM for launching programs, features and initiatives to improve returns experience, reduce defects and refunds, and manage portfolio once launched. Align product vision with long-term business goals and influence cross-functional teams to deliver on that vision. Standardize processes across different business units and align recommended processes with stakeholders. Support with a business perspective other supply chain initiatives.

Continuous Improvement

Own returns and concessions at a process and experience level. Define and monitor metrics, perform root cause analysis on defects and implement remediation; own continuous improvement strategy. Function as a main point of contact for escalations, coordinating multi-functionally to provide advice, implement solutions, and monitor resolution on concessions, abuse, defects and supply chain topics.

About The Team

Joining the CFX team means partnering with a dynamic and creative group who set a high bar for innovation and success in a fast-paced and changing environment.

Basic Qualifications


 5+ years of product or program management, product marketing, business development or technology experience
 Bachelor's degree or equivalent
 Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
 Experience with end to end product delivery
 Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
 Experience as a product manager or owner
 Experience owning technology products
 Experience in English-language communication skills, both written and verbal


Preferred Qualifications


 Experience in influencing senior leadership through data driven insights
 Experience working across functional teams and senior stakeholders

title: Medical Billing Specialist: Insurance Denials & Claims Follow-Up (US Healthcare)
description:
Video from the founder about this role: https://www.loom.com/share/f773b37184544fab9e3301327e643458




This is a US medical billing role. You need hands-on experience working health insurance claims (CMS-1500 / UB-04) for a medical practice, hospital, or medical billing company. General accounts receivable, B2B collections, accounting, or invoicing experience does not qualify.




About Notics




Notics builds and runs custom healthcare operating systems for medical practices: one system that connects the clinical record, billing, scheduling, and back office, built around how each practice actually works. We've supported healthcare companies for about ten years.




Our Revenue Cycle team is the human side of that system. The software handles what can be automated: eligibility, claim scrubbing, auto-posting matched payments, routing denials by code, and resubmitting simple fixes. You handle what still needs an experienced person. You'll work as an embedded part of each client's billing team, in their group chat and their daily workflow, not as an outsourced vendor behind a ticket queue.




What you'll do




Work denials and find out what's really wrong




- Work the denials routed to our team. Read the reason and remark codes (CARC/RARC), decide whether it's a fix you can make or one the practice must make, and act on it.

- Call payers when the code doesn't tell the story (CO-16 and the other "tells you nothing" codes). Ask the right questions, recognize when a rep doesn't actually know, and get the real answer the first time, so a claim doesn't go back four times.

- Chase down credentialing and authorization denials where the provider is credentialed or the auth is on file: is it a loop in the payer's system, EDI, their provider directory, a wrong NPI on our side?

- Build and send corrected claims (replacement and void), most often fixing billing provider, place of service, modifiers (KX, GP, and others), and diagnosis code order.




Follow up on unpaid claims




- Follow up on claims with no payment or denial past the payer's window. That includes auto no-fault carriers who are required to respond within 30 days and often don't.

- Check claim status by phone, payer portal, or electronic status check.

- Handle coordination-of-benefits problems: send the primary payer's EOB with secondary claims, sort out secondary payment issues, and escalate patterns (for example, a payer that consistently fails to pay as secondary).




Commercial, government, and liability payers




- Commercial (heavy Blue Cross Blue Shield volume), Medicare/Medicare Advantage, and Medicaid plans.

- Property and casualty: auto no-fault and workers' comp. Know the documentation they need (notes with every claim), and spot the denials that need the practice's attention right away: claim under investigation, utilization review, not related to the accident.




Post payments




- Post insurance payments from ERAs and paper EOBs, including the exceptions the system can't auto-post.

- Follow each practice's rules on which patient-responsibility amounts can and can't move to the patient (for example, terminated coverage stays with insurance until resolved).




Patient statements and balances




- Run the patient statement cycle (30/60/90 days) and handle patient billing questions.

- Watch high-balance accounts and recommend bad-debt or write-off actions to the practice for approval.




Communicate clearly with the practice




- When you need something from the practice, say exactly what you need ("this code isn't payable for this payer, we need a new diagnosis code from the provider"), not just why the claim was denied.

- Raise urgent issues fast: benefit maximum reached, coverage terminated, liability carrier denying responsibility. These can mean services must pause before a client runs up a large balance.




Make the system better




- You'll see which denials keep coming back and why. Tell us, so we can fix it upstream, route it automatically, or resolve it without a person.

- Help document what your payer calls cover and how you work each denial. That becomes the playbook (and the training data) for automating more of this work over time, which frees you for the harder cases.

- Follow each client's SOP for what you do and don't do in their system.




What you bring




- 3+ years in US medical billing, working health insurance claims, with real time spent on denial management and insurance AR follow-up, not only charge entry. Commercial or B2B collections does not count.

- Strong payer phone skills. You know how to get a straight answer from a commercial payer and when to ask for a supervisor or a reference number.

- Working knowledge of CARC/RARC codes, CMS-1500/837P claims, corrected claim frequency codes (7 and 8), modifiers, place of service, and EOB/ERA reading.

- Experience with coordination of benefits and secondary claims.

- Comfortable in payer portals, clearinghouses, and at least one practice management system (AdvancedMD, Kareo/Tebra, WebPT, athena, or similar).

- Clear, plain written communication. Much of your work will be telling a billing team exactly what you need and why.

- Comfortable learning new software quickly and giving honest feedback on it.

- Fluent spoken and written English. You'll be on the phone with US payers every day.

- Available during US business hours, with a reliable internet connection and a quiet place to take calls.




Nice to have




- Outpatient rehab billing (PT, OT, speech): the Medicare 8-minute rule, AMA midpoint rule, KX modifier and therapy thresholds, plans of care.

- Auto no-fault and workers' comp billing, including state no-fault rules.

- Credentialing and payer enrollment experience.

- CPC, CPB, CRCR, or similar certification.

- Experience at an RCM company or billing service supporting several practices.




Pay and schedule




- $1,500–$2,500 USD per month, based on experience.

- Full-time contract: 40 hours a week, Monday to Friday.

- Independent contractor, paid directly in USD.

- 100% remote, open to anyone in Latin America.

- US business hours (Eastern).




Why this role




- You'll work the interesting part of RCM: the denials that need judgment. Software handles the repetitive work.

- You'll have a direct line to the people building the system. When something's broken or slow, you tell the people who can fix it.

- You'll be part of the client's team, not a faceless vendor.
